title: Pythos pairs an AI maths tutor with deterministic checking tools
friendlyTitle: Pythos explains maths and also checks the working
summary: Pythos is a free mathematics and physics tutor that combines conversational explanations with a step verifier, scientific calculator, graphing, unit conversion and matrix tools. It also publishes a mathematical validation record and tells users to double-check important results.
friendlySummary: Pythos is a free AI tutor for maths and physics. It includes normal calculation tools that can check answers, draw graphs and convert units alongside the chat.
whyItMatters: The design separates explanation from verification instead of asking a language model to be both teacher and final authority. Students can use the conversational layer to understand a method, then use deterministic tools to check concrete calculations.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI can help explain an idea, while a separate calculator checks the exact result. Using both is safer than trusting a confident answer from chat alone.
